x-e-e5-04.title: Yaadni kee poostara yeroo dubbistu jijjiirama
x-e-e5-04.goal: Yeroo odeeffannoon poostaraa tarkaanfii tarkaanfiitti ifa ba'u hundatti murtee kee jijjiiri, akkasumas odeeffannoo poostara irra hin jirre mirkaneessu gaaffii Afaan Ingiliizii hojjedhu.
x-e-e5-04.material: Jun miseensa Green Library miti. Hiriyaan isaa Ara miseensa Green Library dha. Lamaan isaanii poostara fuula mana kitaabaa dura jiru sarara tokko tokkoon dubbisuuf deemaa jiru.
x-e-e5-04.thinking.0: Yeroo odeeffannoo haaraa quunnamtu hundatti murtee kee jijjiiri
x-e-e5-04.thinking.2: Wanta duraanuu deebisame fi wanta ammallee hin beeknu adda baasuu
x-e-e5-04.prereq.0: Hiika free, member, friend, fi won (KRW)
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.prompt: Odeeffannoon tokko tokkoon ifa ba'a. Yeroo hundaa, odeeffannoo hanga ammaatiin maallaqa Jun kaffalu tilmaami.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hima yeroo kanaa haaraa murtee duraa kee jijjiira moo hin jijjiirre mirkaneeffadhu.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Jun moo Ara miseensa akka ta'e adda baasuuf of eeggannoon dubbisi.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Mata duree poostaraa: FREE ART CAMP! This Sunday. Green Library.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mata duree kana qofa yoo ilaalle, Jun maallaqa kaffalaa?
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Mata duree qofaan 'bilisa' fakkaata, garuu barreeffama xiqqaa keessa haalli jiraachuu danda'a.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kaffaluun isa hin barbaachisu jedheen yaada.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kun tilmaama jalqabaa FREE mata dureetiin qofa murteesse dha.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kun murtee mata duree alatti haalli jiraachuu danda'a jedhee ilaale dha.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Jechoonni kaffaluu itti himan ammaaf hin jiran.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Barreeffama xiqqaa: Free for Green Library members. Other children: 5,000 won.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Jun miseensa miti. Amma Jun meeqa kaffala?
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Miseensotaaf qofa bilisa dha fi daa'imman biroof 5,000 won dha, kanaaf Jun 5,000 won kaffala.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Haala miseensotaaf qofa bilisa ta'u dhabde ta'uu danda'a.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sarara daa'imman miseensa hin taane irratti argee walitti hidhe.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Jechoonni seenuun hin eeyyamamu jedhan hin jiran.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Gara gadii: Members can bring one friend for free.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Jun Ara, kan miseensa ta'e, waliin yoo deeme, meeqa kaffala?
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Miseensi hiriyyaa tokko bilisaan fiduu danda'a. Ara miseensa dha, kanaaf Jun Ara waliin yoo deeme bilisa dha.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Sararri haaraan haala Jun irratti hojjetu moo hin hojjenne irra deebi'ii mirkaneeffadhu.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Haala sarara duraa qofa ilaalte, sarara haaraa hin yaadne ta'uu danda'a.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 0 won (sababni isaas hiriyyaa Ara fide dha)
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Sarara haaraa hariiroo nama lamaanii waliin walitti hidha.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.reflect: Murtee kee 'bilisa' sarara lammaffaa irratti jijjiirte, fi sarara sadaffaa irratti deebi'ii jijjiirte. Jechoonni kam murtee kee akka jijjiiran, fi yeroo jalqabaa mata duree qofa amantee maal akka dhabde, duubatti ilaali.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.prompt: Odeeffannoo poostaraan ammaaf hin kennin jira (fakkeenyaaf, sa'aatii meeqatti akka jalqabu, akkamitti akka galmaa'u). Hima Ingiliffaa tokko gaaffii odeeffannoo akkasii mirkaneessu barreessi. Gaaffii maallaqa dhiisi, sababni isaas duraanuu deebisameera.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Poostaraan 'guyyaa' qaba garuu 'sa'aatii' ykn 'akkamitti galmaa'uu' qaba moo hin qabne barbaadi.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wanta ammallee hin beekne tokko filadhu, gaaffiitti barreessi, fi mallattoo gaaffii kaa'i.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Deebiin gaaffii kootii dhugumaan poostara irra hin jiruu?
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Gaaffiin wanta tokko qofa ifatti gaafataa?

x-e-e5-01.title: 'Most popular' - barreeffamni deeggaraa?
x-e-e5-01.goal: Odeeffannoon lakkoofsaa barreeffama keessa jiru ibsa (popular) deeggaruu isaa yaadi, akkasumas gaaffii Afaan Ingiliizii ibsa sana mirkaneessu hojjedhu.
x-e-e5-01.material:
Kutaan Mina kutaa dubbisuu ciraa kitaabaa qabu qaba.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
x-e-e5-01.thinking.0: Ibsa sana bal'ina barreeffamaa waliin wal bira qabi
x-e-e5-01.prereq.0: Jechoota salphaa akka most, popular, fi about
x-e-e5-01.prereq.1: Jechoota lakkoofsaa akka Twelve fi four
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.prompt: Barreeffamni jecha Mina (kitaabonni bineensaa baay'ee jaallatamu) deeggaruu isaa murteessi.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Jecha Mina keessatti 'popular' maal jechuu akka ta'e yaadi, akkasumas hima barreeffama keessa isa kana himu barbaadi.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.hint.1: 'Ciraa irratti meeqa jiru' fi 'barattoonni al meeqa dubbisan' odeeffannoo wal-fakkaataa ta'uu isaa yaadi.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.a: Ragaan gahaa dha. Kitaaba 20 keessaa 12 kitaaba bineensaa dha, kanaaf barattoonni isaan baay'ee dubbisu ta'a.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.a: Baay'ina kitaabaa fi baay'ina yeroo dubbifamanii wanta tokko godhanii ilaaltaniiru moo hin ilaalle irra deebi'ii ilaali.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.b: Ragaan gahaa miti. Baay'ina kitaabaa qofa qaba, barattoonni kitaaba kam dubbisan hin jedhu.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.b: Odeeffannoo ibsi barbaadu fi odeeffannoo barreeffamni kennu wal-fakkaataa ta'uu isaa wal bira qabeera.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.c: Ragaan gahaa dha. Kitaabni haaraan hin bitamne, kanaaf barattoonni kitaaba dulloomaa qofa dubbisu.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.c: 'Did not buy new books' kitaabni kam jaallatamaa akka ta'e waliin wal-qabata moo hin wal-qabatne mirkaneessi.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.explain: Barreeffamni baay'ina kitaabaa ciraa irra jiru qofa dubbata (kitaaba bineensaa 12, fi kkf). Barattoonni kitaaba kam baay'ee dubbisan ykn liqeefatan hin jedhu, kanaaf ibsa 'most popular' mirkaneessuu hin dandeenyu.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.prompt: Jecha Mina sirrii moo hin taane mirkaneessuuf, barattoota gaaffii maal gaafachuu qabda? Hima gaaffii Afaan Ingiliizii tokko barreessi.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hojii 'popular' agarsiisu tokko filadhu (dubbisuu, liqeeffachuu, filachuu).
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gaaffii hojii sanaa gaafatu barreessi, dhuma irratti mallattoo gaaffii kaa'i.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Deebiin gaaffii kootii 'kitaabni kam baay'ee dubbifama' jedhu himaa?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Waa'ee wanta barattoonni hojjetan gaafataa, baay'ina kitaabaa osoo hin gaafatin?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Gaaffii gaarii kan biraa baay'ina liqeeffachuun mirkaneessu.

x-e-e5-05.title: Yaada ijoo fi himoota deeggarsa barreeffama iddoo biqiltuu mana barumsaa keessatti
x-e-e5-05.goal: Yaada ijoo himoota keessaa filadhu, bal'ina yaada ijoo deeggaran dhugaa salphaa irraa adda baasi, achiis hima deeggarsaa mataa kee hojjedhu.
x-e-e5-05.thinking.0: Yaada ijoo bal'ina irraa adda baasuu
x-e-e5-05.thinking.1: Odeeffannoo deeggaru fi odeeffannoo wal-qabateef hin qabne adda baasuu
x-e-e5-05.thinking.2: Hima bal'ina yaada ijoo waliin simatu hojjechuu
x-e-e5-05.prereq.0: Hiika garden, plant, insect, fi seed
x-e-e5-05.prereq.1: Muuxannoo kutaan barreeffamaa yaada guddaa tokko fi yaada xiqqaa irraa hojjetame
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.prompt: Hima kamtu yaada ijoo barreeffama guutuu isa caalaa simata?
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Filannoon tokko tokkoo kutaa barreeffamaa tokko qofa dubbata moo barreeffama guutuu haguuga wal bira qabi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Filannoo tokko himoota barreeffamaa hundaa waliin walitti hidhi, fi himoota hedduu waliin walitti hidhamu argi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.a: Kun yaada ijoo akka bal'ina hima tokko barreeffamaa keessatti ilaala.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.b: Kun dhugaa iddoo himu dha. Himoota biroo waliin walitti hidhamu moo hin hidhamne mirkaneeffadhu.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.c: Kun yaada ijoo akka wanta tokko hojii guyyaa guyyaa keessaa qofa ilaala.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.d: Filannoon kun qabiyyeen himoota hedduu tokkotti hidhamuu danda'a moo hin dandeenye yaade.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.explain: Iddoo biqiltuu keessatti biqiltuu dhaabuu, bishaan obaasuu, ilaaluu fi hargansuu, fi wanta kanniisoonni hojjetan baruun hundi yaada guddaa 'iddoon biqiltuu iddoo barachuu dha' jedhuun walitti hidhamu. Filannoowwan kaan tokko tokkoon dhugaa isaan keessaa tokko qofa.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.prompt: Himoota yaada ijoo 'The garden helps students learn.' deeggaran hundaa filadhu.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Filannoo tokko tokkoo dubbisii, 'Kun ragaa barattoonni baratan dhaa?' jedhii of gaafadhu.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dura filannoowwan dhugaa garuu barachuu waliin hariiroo hin qabne haqi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.a: Dhugaa barachuu waliin walitti hidhamu dha moo hin dhidhamne yaadi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.b: Filannoon kun wanta barattoonni hojjetan ragaa barachuu dha moo hin taane yaade.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.c: Hima wanta baratame kallattiin himu argee walitti hidhe.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.d: Odeeffannoon iddoo barachuu agarsiisa moo hin agarsiisu yaadi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.explain: Animalii ilaaluu fi barreessuu, fi wanta kanniisoota ilaalchisee baratan ragaa barachuu dha. Iddoon biqiltuu xiqqaa ta'uu fi mana boqonnaa cinaa jiraachuun dhugaa dha, garuu odeeffannoo barachuu waliin hariiroo hin qabne dha.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.prompt: Hima Ingiliffaa haaraa yaada ijoo 'The garden helps students learn.' deeggaru tokko hojjedhu. Barreeffama keessa hin jiraatiyyuu gaarii dha.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Wanta barattoonni iddoo biqiltuu keessatti arguu danda'an tokko ykn wanta hojjechuu danda'an tokko yaadi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Hima tokkoon, jecha gochaa akka 'learn, observe, write' fayyadamuun, barreessi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni koo ragaa barattoonni iddoo biqiltuu keessatti baratan dhaa?
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Guddina ykn bakka iddoo biqiltuu qofa dubbachuu irraa of eegdeettaa?
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Hima gaarii biraa hojii ilaaluu irratti barreeffame.

x-e-e5-02.title: Sarara dogoggora cuunfaa Jin keessatti argadhii sirreessi
x-e-e5-02.topic: Barreeffamoota gabaabaa, beeksisa, fi ergaa dubbisuu
x-e-e5-02.goal: Barreeffama gabaabaa fi sarara cuunfaa sarara sarara wal bira qabi, sarara barreeffama faallessu argadhii Afaan Ingiliiziitiin irra deebi'ii barreessi.
x-e-e5-02.material:
Barreeffama gabaabaa waa'ee Ben.

Ben went to the lake on Saturday. He wanted to fish, but it rained in the morning, so he stayed at his uncle's house and played cards. In the afternoon the rain stopped. Ben and his uncle walked to the lake and caught two fish. They cooked the fish for dinner.
x-e-e5-02.thinking.0: Sarara cuunfaa tokkoon tokkoon isaa hima barreeffamaa waliin wal bira qabi
x-e-e5-02.thinking.1: Tartiiba taateewwanii fi yeroo (ganama/waaree booda) mirkaneessi
x-e-e5-02.thinking.2: Hima barreeffama waliin akka wal-simu irra deebi'ii barreessi
x-e-e5-02.prereq.0: Jechoota salphaa akka rain, lake, fish, fi cook
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.prompt: Cuunfaan Jin barreeffama kanaa sarara afuri dha. Sarara barreeffama waliin hin wal-simne filadhu.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara cuunfaa tokko tokkoon dubbisi, hima barreeffama keessatti qabiyyee wal-fakkaataan itti mul'atu argadhii cinaa cinaan kaa'i.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Jechoota yeroo agarsiisan (morning, afternoon, all day) mallattoo godhii barreeffama waliin wal bira qabi.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.explain: Sararri 2 dogoggora. Barreeffama keessatti rooba ganama qofa roobe, waaree booda dhaabate, kanaaf Ben waaree booda qurxummii qabe. Sararri 1, 3, fi 4 barreeffama waliin wal-simu.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarara dogoggoraa Afaan Ingiliiziitiin irra deebi'ii barreessi akka barreeffama waliin wal-simu. Hima tokko ykn lama gahaa dha.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Duraan barreeffama keessatti yoom akka roobe fi yoom akka dhaabate argadhu.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yeroo lamaan sana (morning, afternoon) hima sirreeffame kee keessa galchi.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ganama qofa akka roobe jedhu hammateeraa?
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Bu'aa isaatiin waaree booda qurxummii qabuu waliin wal-simaa?
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Deebii kan biraa 'only in the morning' jedhuun sirreesse.

x-e-e5-03.topic: Barreeffamoota gabaabaa, beeksisa, fi ergaa dubbisuu
x-e-e5-03.title: Beeksisa mana gurgurtaa baaskilii: karoora Mia ilaali
x-e-e5-03.goal: Haala beeksisa keessa jiru (har'a qofa, yeroo cufamu) karoora hiriyaa waliin sarara sarara wal bira qabi, kutaalee hin wal-simne argadhii, Afaan Ingiliiziitiin isheef himi.
x-e-e5-03.material:
Beeksisni kun daandii irratti Mia'f mul'ate (barreeffamaan qofa, fakkii malee).

RIDE BIKE SHOP
BIG SALE! All bikes 30% off.
Today only!
Open 9 a.m. - 6 p.m.
12 Park Street

(30% 'thirty percent' jedhamee dubbifama.)
x-e-e5-03.thinking.0: Jechoota beeksisaa sarara karoora tokkoon tokkoon isaa waliin wal bira qabi
x-e-e5-03.thinking.1: Haala akka today only fi 6 p.m. mirkaneessi
x-e-e5-03.thinking.2: Wanta hin mijaa'in ragaa kennuudhaan himi
x-e-e5-03.prereq.0: Hiika sale, open, bike, fi off
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.prompt: Karoorri Mia sarara afuriin dhiyaate. Sarara beeksisa waliin hin wal-simne tokko filadhu. (Sararri hin wal-simne lama ykn isaa ol ta'uu danda'u. Tokko qofa filachuu dandeessa.)
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara beeksisaa tokko tokkoon yeroo dubbistu, jechoota guyyaa ykn yeroo eeru jala sarari.
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sarara Mia keessaa, sarara guyyaa ykn yeroo dubbatan jecha sana beeksisa keessa jiru waliin wal bira qabi.
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.explain: Sararri 3 'Today only!' irraa kan ka'e dogoggora dha (boru hin gurguramu), sararri 4 immoo dukaanni sa'aatii 6 p.m. cufama garuu sa'aatii 7 p.m. deema jetti waan ta'eef dogoggora dha. Sararri 1 fi 2 beeksisa waliin wal-simu.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.prompt: Mia'f Afaan Ingiliiziitiin deebii kenni. Wanta karoora ishee keessa hin hojjenne tokko sababa isaa waliin isheef himi.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Jecha beeksisa keessaa rakkoo ta'e tokko filadhii akkuma jirutti galchi.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.hint.1: So, kan 'so I can't ...' jechuu dha, fayyadamuun hima tokkotti walitti hidhi.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jechi beeksisaa kam sababa hin hojjenne ta'e jette jirtaa?
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Karaa sirreessuu (har'a deemuu, sa'aatii 6 dura deemuu) dabalteettaa? (filannoo)

x-e-e5-08.title: 'Meet at the cinema!' Maal gaafadha?
x-e-e5-08.goal: Odeeffannoo ergaa hiriyyaa irraa dhabame qindeessi, fi gaaffii dhugumaan barbaachisu Ingiliffaan barreessi.
x-e-e5-08.material:
Dana fi Eli hiriyyoota kutaa dha. Magaalaa Dana jiraattu keessa sinemaa lama jira: Star Cinema fi Moon Cinema.

Eli Dana'f ergaa barreeffamaa erge.

Eli: "Let's see a movie on Saturday! I will buy the tickets. Meet me at the cinema!"
x-e-e5-08.thinking.0: Wanta ergaan duraanuu jedhu fi wanta dhabame adda baasuu
x-e-e5-08.thinking.1: Odeeffannoo kaayyoo (wal arguu) tiif dhugumaan barbaachisu filachuu
x-e-e5-08.prereq.1: Bifa gaaffii akka What time ...? / Which ...?
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.prompt: Dana Eli waliin Sanbata mirkanaa'ee wal arguuf wantoota gaafachuu qabdu hundaa filadhu.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.hint.0: Dura odeeffannoo barreeffamni duraanuu kennu (guyyaa, tikeetii) mallatteessi.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.hint.1: 'Wal arguuf' wanta barbaachisu qofa eegi. Gaaffii gaarii ta'u garuu isaan malee wal arguu dandeessu dhiisi.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.a: Filannoon kun odeeffannoon wal arguuf barbaachisu sa'aatii ta'uu isaa hubate.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.b: Filannoon kun sinemaa lama jiraachuu isaa barreeffama waliin walitti hidhe.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.c: Barreeffamni eenyutu tikeetii bitu jedhe irra deebi'ii mirkaneeffadhu.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.d: Gaaffii gaarii ta'u dha, garuu wal arguuf dhugumaan barbaachisaa moo hin taane yaadi.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.explain: Barreeffamni guyyaa (Sanbata) fi Eli tikeetii akka bitu qaba, garuu yeroo meeqatti akka wal argan fi sinemaa kam akka ta'e hin qabu. Magaalaa keessatti sinemaan lama jira, kanaaf lamaanuu gaafachuu qabda. Fiilmiin ati jaallattu wal argiif dhugumatti hin barbaachisu.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.prompt: Deebii Dana Eliif ergu Ingliffaan barreessi. Gaaffilee dhugumatti barbaachisan lamaanuu dabali.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.hint.0: Lamaan s1 keessatti filatte tokkoon tokkoo himicha tokkoon akka gaaffiitti barreessi.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.hint.1: Gaaffiin yeroo ilaalu What time jedhuun jalqabuu danda'a, gaaffiin bakka ilaalu Which ykn Where jedhuun jalqabuu danda'a.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Gaaffiin yeroo fi sinemaa lamaanuu keessa jiruu?
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Eli deebii kana qofa dubbisee battaluma deebisuu danda'aa?
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Deebii gaarii kan biraa bakka fi yeroo jalqabaa gaafate.

x-e-e5-06.title: Beeksisa Guyyaa Daakuu lama: maaltu adda?
x-e-e5-06.goal: Beeksisa lama wanta tokko tokkoon wal bira qabi, 'garaagarri dhugaa' fi wantoota 'adda fakkaatan garuu faallaa hin taane' adda baasi, fi gaaffii mirkaneessu Ingiliffaan barreessi.
x-e-e5-06.material:
Beeksisa Guyyaa Daakuu lama mana barumsaa Mina irraa dhufe.

Beeksisa A (waajjira mana barumsaa)
Swim Day. Date: Friday, June 7.
Meet: school gate, 8:30 a.m.
Bring: swimsuit, towel, swimming cap.
